title: Whiskey, Beasts, and a Caustic Waterfall
summary: In a dimly lit backroom, a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, and oil-stained mechanic coveralls faced down a ganging crowd. Whispered tricks and a bluffed upfront gamble over whiskey, washers, and wontons, all to subjoin an irksome link. Despair mounted as a clumsy, nerfed device was mucked with, a desperate joyride against a looming deadlock. The climax hit when a glassy beast, reflected in the compass, brought a jumpy gimmick to the fore. Apathy and a chasmic corpse challenged their prized knowledge, but a unity was forged, absorbing the lagniappe. Now, a caustic waterfall flows, the old regency in decline. They uncorked a true utility, flicking away invective, no longer borrowed. A vocalist sings a benediction, for subsistence and freedom anymore.
protagonist: a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls

The air is thick with a sense of impending tricks.
